storage: Airtight jar in the fridge for up to 6 months, because the oil turns rancid quickly in Mumbai's warmth and humidity. Keep chopped pistachios separate and add them just before eating, as the dish does; they go soft and lose their colour in a wet jar overnight.
looksLike: Small, oval kernels, pale green to yellow-green with a thin purple-brown skin; the kernel is soft and slightly chewy.
howToPick: Choose kernels that are bright green and plump, with no black or white mould spots, no bitter or musty smell and no sticky, oily surface. Faded yellow-brown kernels are old. Check the pack says unsalted and not roasted (or you will pay for salt).
shelfLife: About 6 months sealed; shelled kernels go stale faster than in-shell nuts.

usedIn.raw: 4 g unsalted pistachios per serving (5–6 pistachios, chopped)
